none.description:
sh-stroke/none
Purpose: No visible outline. Use only where the component does not need a boundary.

thin.description:
sh-stroke/thin
Purpose: Subtle outline thickness for fine dividers and low-emphasis borders.

default.description:
sh-stroke/default
Purpose: Standard outline thickness for everyday controls and containers.

medium.description:
sh-stroke/medium
Purpose: Outline thickness when Default lacks enough visual definition.

strong.description:
sh-stroke/strong
Purpose: High-emphasis outline thickness when Medium is still too subtle.
